title: lobelia nitida
intro: Lobelia nitida, commonly known as "Blue Lobelia", is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It is a perennial plant native to North America, known for its blue or purple flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is valued for its ability to act as a respiratory stimulant, improving circulation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. Bioactive constituents of Lobelia nitida include alkaloids like lobeline and lobelanine, which exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilatory properties, making it a therapeutic agent in traditional herbal medicine.
